bugs.description: simulate_fate production was sigmoid(2*signal): a 0.5 basal production floor put every gene at ~50% expression with zero regulators (TNNT2 steady state 1.43 with no activator). Fixed to thresholded sigmoid(6*(signal-0.5)); quiet TNNT2 steady state is now 0.20 and single-driver activation is ~0.95.

optimal-control stack: (i) controls could force structural markers directly; (ii) terminal error treated unspecified targets as 0, penalizing needed driver activation (pre-fix fibroblast->cardiomyocyte recipe: REPRESS NANOG/SOX2/MEF2C/TBX5, the opposite of the Ieda GMT protocol); (iii) L-BFGS-B default finite-difference step (~1e-8) sat below ODE solver noise, freezing the optimizer at zero control for distant targets; (iv) deterministic integration allowed negative concentrations and the x^2 Hill term made negative GATA4 act as an activator (sign exploit). Fixed: TF-only controls, error over specified targets only, eps=1e-3, Hill input clamped at 0, validation masked to specified targets.

caveats: OCT4 is an HGNC alias of POU5F1 (module uses the common alias); the other 19 gene symbols are approved HGNC symbols
GRN coverage gaps: KLF4 and MYC (OSKM) and POU3F2/Brn2 (BAM) are absent from the curated network
the OCT4-SOX2-NANOG mutual-activation loop self-ignites from basal levels (~2.85) unless actively repressed; with specified-only objectives the optimizer is not penalized for it
transition_recipe drivers are direct regulators of target markers only (one-step lookahead; misses pioneer factors such as ASCL1 for the neuron recipe)
sparse recipe keeps |u|>0.01; the optimizer full 18-dim solution can carry smaller load-bearing controls
GRN edge signs are curated from canonical reprogramming literature but not individually weighted
1 attractor found (pluripotency loop dominates random starts), stable to max |rhs| 3.1e-08
